body.zh: 马斯克表示SpaceX将自建燃气轮机部件以满足激增的AI电力需求，这是为xAI/SpaceX算力扩张提供能源保障的具体基建举措。

title.en: Elon Musk Is Spending $119 Billion on A Single Building Outside Houston. Here’s Who Actually Profits.
title.zh: Elon Musk Is Spending $119 Billion on A Single Building Outside Houston. Here’s Who Actually Profits.

body.en: Musk is spending $119 billion on a single AI infrastructure building outside Houston, per reporting on who stands to profit from the project.
body.zh: 据报道，Musk正斥资1190亿美元在休斯顿附近建造一座AI基础设施建筑，报道分析了谁将从该项目中获益。

title.zh: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman joins Elon Musk and Sundar Pichai in their Space data center plans; say

body.en: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman is reported to be joining Musk and Sundar Pichai in plans to build data centers in space.
body.zh: 据报道,NASA局长贾里德·艾萨克曼将加入马斯克和桑达尔·皮查伊的太空数据中心建设计划。

title.en: UAE grants Elon Musk’s Starlink 10-year licence for satellite internet services
title.zh: UAE grants Elon Musk’s Starlink 10-year licence for satellite internet services

body.en: The UAE granted Musk's Starlink a 10-year licence to provide satellite internet services in the country.
body.zh: 阿联酋授予马斯克旗下星链在该国提供卫星互联网服务的10年经营牌照。

title.en: Elon Musk’s 15-Gigawatt Warning Points to a Very Different Set of AI Winners in 2027
title.zh: Elon Musk’s 15-Gigawatt Warning Points to a Very Different Set of AI Winners in 2027

body.en: Musk warned that a coming 15-gigawatt compute buildout will reshape which AI companies win by 2027, tying AI progress directly to power availability.
body.zh: 马斯克警告即将到来的15吉瓦算力建设将重塑到2027年谁能在AI竞争中胜出，将AI进展与电力供应直接挂钩。

title.en: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
title.zh: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX

body.en: OpenAI winds down Cursor's access to its models after SpaceX acquires the coding startup, turning his long-running feud with OpenAI into a supply cut-off between two of the largest AI companies.
body.zh: SpaceX 收购编程创业公司 Cursor 后，OpenAI 终止向其提供模型访问，使他与 OpenAI 的长期恩怨升级为两家最大 AI 公司之间的供应切断。

body.en: His super PAC begins buying online advertising in the 2026 midterms, turning his political money into an active campaign operation.
body.zh: 他的超级政治行动委员会开始在2026年中期选举中投放网络广告，把政治资金变成了实际运作的竞选机器。

title.en: Elon Musk's X Loses First Amendment Challenge to New York's 'Stop Hiding Hate Act'
title.zh: Elon Musk's X Loses First Amendment Challenge to New York's 'Stop Hiding Hate Act'

body.en: A court rejects X's First Amendment challenge to New York's Stop Hiding Hate Act, leaving his platform bound by the state's content-moderation disclosure rules.
body.zh: 法院驳回了X对纽约州《停止隐藏仇恨法》的第一修正案挑战，他旗下平台仍须遵守该州的内容审核披露规定。
